saathi.title: SAATHI
saathi.line: A voice-AI phone assistant that answers real calls in English, Hindi and Kannada.

pts: Small businesses and individuals miss calls or serve callers in different languages.
Telephony APIs cost money; the aim was real calls without paid telephony.
First target: health screening for feature-phone users.
An agent that answers a real phone call and replies in the caller's own language: English, Hindi or Kannada.
Version 1 in Python: controls an Android phone with ADB and Scrcpy, using Groq with Whisper and Piper.
Version 2 in Rust and Tauri: a desktop app (VoidRelay) with Android and iOS companion apps (VoidCaller).
Offline mode with local Whisper, Ollama and Piper.
Phone connects to the PC over WebSocket on port 7331 with a 10 s heartbeat.
Audio is captured into a lock-free ring buffer.
Voice activity detection: speech of 300 ms or more starts an utterance; 800 ms of silence ends it.
The mic is muted while the AI speaks, so it never hears itself.
Speech to text: Sarvam online, or whisper-rs offline.
LLM: Groq Llama 3.3 70B streaming, or Ollama Llama 3.2 3B offline.
Text to speech: Sarvam Bulbul (Hindi, Kannada) or local Piper.
Each finished sentence goes to speech at once, so the caller hears the first sentence early.
An engine router picks online or offline and checks Groq reachability every 30 s.
Version 1 responded in around 300 ms [author tests, not an audited benchmark]
Call state machine from Idle to Ended with eight states.
SQLite call history and an optional Telegram bot (/call, /hangup, /mode, /say).
Registry of 18 models with a hardware profiler that recommends downloads.
The call and voice pipeline was reused in KAVACH and VeriFarm.

character.name: Saathi
character.persona: Warm, steady switchboard operator who speaks in clear short lines.

argus.title: ARGUS
argus.line: A multi-camera AI surveillance platform that runs on an 8 GB MacBook.

achievements.s: Accepted and published, Patent Office Journal 41/2026. Filed jointly with five co-applicants.

pts: Security teams and law enforcement cannot watch dozens of camera feeds at once.
Sending every frame to a cloud model is far too costly and slow.
Operators search every camera by description, face photo or number plate instead of scrubbing footage.
Up to six camera slots: phones, IP cameras, RTSP, USB and video files.
A Next.js dashboard with live frames, events and system telemetry.
A worker per camera keeps only the newest frame, downscaled to 640x360.
One shared YOLOv8n watches every feed and counts people and vehicles.
Four triggers wake the cloud: count change, scene change, 20 s heartbeat, active search.
Stage 1: a vision-language model names up to three specialist detectors for the scene.
Specialists load on demand: three in memory, least recently used leaves.
Stage 2: the cropped detection is checked again by a second model call to cut false alarms.
Events are de-duplicated within 10 s, saved with two evidence images, and stored in SQLite.
Search by face (ArcFace), by clothing fingerprint when the face is hidden, or by plate OCR.
A router spreads load across 20 API keys with cooldown and failover.
971 cloud calls instead of 466,523 for per-frame streaming, 99.8% fewer [2-hour field run, 3 phone cameras]
Peak backend memory 1,078 MB against about 5,650 MB for loading every model [same run]
Stage 2 suppressed 2 of 4 specialist triggers as false alarms [same run]
Edge detector: 19.9 ms per frame, about 50 FPS [M1, 8 GB]
Cross-camera search followed one suspect through 31 transitions in 10 min 58 s [same run]

character.name: Argus
character.persona: Observant watchman who tracks camera feeds and hates wasted cloud calls.

soil-and-toil.title: SOIL & TOIL
soil-and-toil.line: Soil nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium and pH from one phone photo.

pts: Farmers cannot easily reach or afford soil-testing labs.
Lab results are slow, and fertiliser is often guessed.
One phone photo gives nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium, pH and soil type.
Fertiliser advice for 30 crops in English, Hindi and Kannada.
A web app with a background job queue and live progress.
The browser sends photo, location, crop, acreage and language; progress is polled every 2 s.
The photo is resized to 512x512 and white-balanced.
An MST++ transformer rebuilds a spectrum from RGB; the near-infrared part is extrapolated.
Smoothing, scaling and derivatives give 188 features; PCA cuts them to 30.
pH and soil type are predicted first, because pH changes nutrient availability.
NPK comes from a PLSR plus 1D-CNN ensemble; 50 dropout passes give a 95% confidence range.
Weather and soil context from Open-Meteo and SoilGrids; deficit compared with the chosen crop.
Groq writes the advice in the chosen language, with a static fallback plan.
Cleaned OSSL, AfSIS and Kaggle data; 10-fold cross-validation.
32 saved end-to-end analysis runs.
Heuristic fallbacks if model weights are missing.

character.name: Mitti
character.persona: Grounded, practical soil guide built for real farmland decisions.

axiom.title: AXIOM
axiom.line: A payment safety layer for AI agents that pay for APIs on their own.

achievements.s: Google Developer Groups, REVA University, National

pts: Agents that pay for APIs can overspend, pay fake endpoints or be hijacked.
Teams need to give agents spending power with limits that are enforced.
A governance and audit layer on HTTP 402 (Payment Required), built with team CleverFyre.
Six Algorand Testnet contracts: PolicyVault, IntentRegistry, SentinelEscrow, PaymentDNARegistry, ConsensusVault, ReputationLedger.
An SDK for identity, intent, anomaly and semantic checks, plus a dashboard.
The server answers 402; the agent starts the checks before paying.
Identity: key derived from the agent's source code, so changed code means a new address.
Intent: a JSON record of what, why and how much, sealed in a Merkle tree; only the 32-byte root goes on-chain.
Dead Man's Switch: if the agent goes silent, its cap steps from normal to 1 ALGO, 0.1 ALGO, then frozen.
Semantic router compares the API URL with approved categories, offline.
Anomaly checks: burst limit plus an Isolation Forest.
Escrow holds funds; optional M-of-N peer approval.
An SLA oracle checks status, latency and valid JSON, then releases or refunds.
Stress test: 4 of 4 scenarios passed.
Red-team: 5 of 6 attacks blocked [report.json]
55 saved intent documents.
Six contracts deployed on Algorand Testnet.

character.name: Bouncer Bot
character.persona: Strict vault doorman who checks every agent's budget and intent before paying.

personaforge.title: PERSONAFORGE
personaforge.line: A visual studio for building consistent AI personalities without writing prompts.

pts: Hand-written chatbot prompts are fragile and contradict themselves.
Nobody can trace why a bot behaves the way it does.
A no-code studio: assemble behaviour from 144 blocks in 15 categories, or start from 12 templates.
One persona runs as web chat, a widget, a browser voice agent or a WhatsApp bot.
A TypeScript compiler turns blocks into a deterministic 11-section prompt.
Every line is traced back to the block that produced it.
Conflicts are detected, such as voice mode with markdown, each with a one-click fix.
A 0 to 100 score covers nine checks, such as role, guardrails and fallbacks.
A token budget drops the lowest-priority lines first.
Answers stream by SSE; the first sentence starts speaking early.
Voice agent: record, transcribe, speak, and a second tap interrupts instantly.
A pool of up to ten Groq keys with cooldowns spreads the load.
WhatsApp gateway acknowledges at once, then handles text, images and voice notes.
11 test files across 3 workspaces; 79 of 79 passing [author's report]

character.name: Forge
character.persona: Cheerful workshop robot who cares about deterministic prompts and clear rules.

kavach.title: KAVACH
kavach.line: An AI-agent platform for emergencies: one trigger starts six agents at once.

pts: In danger, nobody can open five apps and make five calls.
Feature-phone users have no app to open at all.
Guardian, a phone app with five triggers: SOS button, the word "kavach", shake, triple volume press and an overdue SafeWalk timer.
If the backend does not answer in 3 seconds, the app falls back to the phone's SMS.
A keypad phone can trigger it with a normal call or SMS.
A Command Center that shows each agent thinking live.
A LangGraph supervisor fans out to six agents in parallel.
Threat: scores severity with a 70B model.
Family alert: WhatsApp messages through Twilio.
FIR: drafts a police report with relevant IPC sections.
Navigation: nearest police, hospital and safe house by Haversine distance.
ARGUS agent: reads camera streams for people, faces and plates.
NCRB agent: adds crime-hotspot context.
A call bridge reads the call queue every 2 s and speaks the brief to police.
Audio, location and CCTV are sensitive data.
False triggers can waste emergency resources.
AI-drafted FIRs must be reviewed by a human.

character.name: Kavach
character.persona: Alert, protective shield hero focused on rapid response and careful human review.

pro-rover.title: PRO-ROVER
pro-rover.line: The software for a low-cost autonomous farm rover: no LiDAR, no Jetson, no RTK.

pts: Field robotics is out of reach for small farms and student labs.
Most rovers need costly sensors and computers.
An Arduino drives two motors and reads three ultrasonic sensors.
An ordinary Android phone is the radio, GPS and accelerometer hub.
A laptop does the thinking and shows a Leaflet map cockpit.
The Arduino reads left, middle and right sonar in turn; a full reading every 150 ms.
The phone relays serial data over Wi-Fi through the USB-TCP Bridge, linked by Tailscale.
A 10 Hz loop computes bearing and distance to the next GPS waypoint.
A PID controller holds the heading on a straight line.
Safety layer: slow below 50 cm, stop below 15 cm, clears at 25 cm.
A 1 second sensor watchdog stops the rover if data goes quiet.
v3.0 adds an LLM tool-calling loop and a vision thread as an agentic experiment.
18 unit tests for navigation maths: geodesic distance, arrival, heading, noise rejection.
v2.0 is the deterministic system I would trust in the field.

character.name: Rovy
character.persona: Scrappy field rover proud of stopping before obstacles without expensive LiDAR.

usb-tcp-bridge.title: USB-TCP BRIDGE
usb-tcp-bridge.line: An Android app that turns a phone into a wireless hub for a robot controller.

achievements.s: SJBIT, 70+ teams, with the Agronym Rover

pts: Robot controllers need a wire, a laptop or an expensive radio.
Small farms and student labs need something affordable.
A native Kotlin app: plug a phone into an Arduino or ESP32 over USB-OTG and it becomes a Wi-Fi bridge.
It forwards bytes both ways between the serial port and a TCP port.
It streams the phone's accelerometer, gyroscope and GPS on their own ports.
Plugging in a supported USB-serial chip launches the service, even with the UI closed.
A foreground service holds a CPU wake lock and a Wi-Fi lock to keep running with the screen off.
Four TCP servers: bridge (1234), telemetry (8001), GPS (8002), ultrasonic (8004).
Bytes are split on newlines; lines starting US: go to the ultrasonic port, the rest to the bridge.
Two bounded queues of 1000 items drop the oldest data so latency stays low.
Fail-safe: if the control connection drops, the app sends M:0,0 and the motors stop.
It is the phone half of the Pro-Rover.
Auto-start on USB attach for FTDI, CP210x, PL2303, CH34x, Arduino, Teensy and more.

character.name: Plug
character.persona: Crisp hardware-bridge connector who speaks cleanly in ports and packet queues.

verifarm.title: VERIFARM
verifarm.line: Farm-to-fork traceability on a shared blockchain, so farmers keep fair value.

pts: Farmers lose fair value because buyers cannot verify where produce came from.
Middlemen can exploit the mandi system.
A shared record that follows produce from farm to consumer across six organisations: government, mandi, farmer co-op, transporter, processor, retailer.
Six Go chaincodes, an Isolation Forest fraud detector and an 8-role mobile app in Kannada, Hindi and English.
Consumers can trace packaged food by QR code.
A farmer gets an ID; Aadhaar and mobile are stored only as SHA-256 hashes.
Each harvest becomes a token with quantity and season.
Mandi sales below the minimum support price are blocked or flagged.
Transport is checked with Haversine distance; a deviation above 50 km is flagged.
Processing yield must fall in a realistic range, such as 82 to 88% for ragi.
A trust score rises with good deliveries and falls with violations.
Detectors run every 30 minutes and 6 hours and push alerts to government users.
Notifications try voice, then WhatsApp, then SMS.
Fabric with Raft ordering and CouchDB.
Node.js, Express, GraphQL, Socket.IO, PostgreSQL with 13 tables.
Turborepo monorepo with Docker.

character.name: Ragi Raja
character.persona: Steady mandi guide focused on fair value for farmers and verified crop records.
